room_directory.config_source: builda.online.json matchKeys via --online-config; without it every matchKey maps to one Room-mode policy from the Scenario
room_directory.isolation: each Room has its own Room instance, module state, Host, seats, tick and empty-Room reclaim
room_directory.room_id: opaque; the Scenario room_id while it is free, otherwise a generation-suffixed ID
room_directory.room_mode: automatic placement fills the fullest released public Room of the same matchKey, then creates one when allow_create and createPublicRoom allow it, otherwise the Ticket waits
room_directory.room_id_admission: public Room-mode Rooms (locked or released) and private Rooms; Pool/RankPool Rooms reject it
room_directory.lock_release: lockRoom/releaseRoom change discovery and automatic placement of public Room-mode Rooms only
room_directory.pool_and_rank_pool: formed locally from waiting single-player Tickets of the same matchKey: oldest first, exact teamCount x teamSize, RankPool score windows from expansionStages widening with the oldest wait, team averages balanced, Bot fill after botPolicy.defaultFillAfterSeconds within minimumHumanPlayers and maximumBotRatio; Rooms are always locked
room_directory.private_rooms: room_private_create when privateRoomsEnabled; never listed or auto-matched
room_directory.roster: Room-mode and private Rooms use the Scenario roster; Pool/RankPool Rooms use the formation roster whose team IDs are team indexes ("0", "1", ...) and whose Bots are roster seats without users
room_directory.confirm: allMembers: an arriving player is connected_pending and receives match_connection_pending; local_room_join is answered and onJoin runs for everyone only when every human has arrived; at the deadline absent Tickets end as confirm_timeout and arrived Tickets return to waiting with their original age, a new version and round, and their pending join fails with MATCH_ASSIGNMENT_STALE
room_directory.confirm_window: min(confirmTimeoutSeconds, 15 s) so that client control requests (20 s) do not time out
room_directory.ticket_deadline: maxMatchSeconds (default 1800 s); a waiting Ticket then ends as timeout / match_deadline
room_directory.room_close: closing a Room (author close, runtime failure, empty-Room reclaim) ends only that Room; a Room closed during Confirm answers waiting joins with ROOM_NOT_FOUND and ends its Tickets as failed / room_lost
room_directory.queue_while_seated: a player in a Room may create a Ticket; Room-mode placement waits until the old Room is left, Pool/RankPool may reach RoomReady meanwhile; local_room_join into another Room while connected, pending or reconnecting elsewhere fails with ROOM_ROLE_BINDING_BUSY; a confirmed Ticket no longer blocks a new Admission
room_directory.ticket_confirmation: as online, a Ticket becomes confirmed only after local_room_joined answered the join, so its confirmed match_ticket_updated push arrives after the client holds the Room handle
room_directory.rejoin_after_leave: after local_room_leave a player cannot enter that Room again with an old Ticket or handle: local_room_join naming that room_id fails with ROOM_PRESENCE_STALE until a new Admission reserves a Seat there
room_directory.ticket_ids: each Admission gets a new Ticket ID (local-ticket-<player>, then -2, -3, ...); earlier Tickets stay readable in a bounded history

room_data_tunnel.note: base64 is used only by the local WebSocket tunnel; online DataChannels send binary frames directly
